nativeWorkspaceCompatibility.method: Independent read-only source compatibility review and SHA256 comparison; no CI rerun

behavior.observation: Uses URLSearchParams and window.location.assign with relative /workspace/open; starts a normal same-origin document GET from the user action. No new native API or custom scheme.
Changed workspace selections use navigateToWorkspace; existing GET forms also target /workspace/open. Same-current-workspace actions keep ordinary client navigation.
Current workspace stays on router.push; different workspace uses the document handoff.
Existing GET checks login, available workspace membership and allowed same-origin destination, updates workspace context, then redirects on the same origin.
HTTPS same host/port is internal. /workspace/open is not in the excluded admin/download paths.

Internal navigation is allowed in the same WKWebView, records main-frame request and uses the existing provisional-start/commit/finish lifecycle. Committed document receives the existing nonce/generation startup context.
No workspace-specific bridge action is required. Existing HTTPS origin readiness protocol and admin-only history exclusion work with this standard document navigation.

nativeWorkspaceCompatibility.conclusion: Workspace switch overlay is web-compatible with actually uploaded native1.0.1(14.1). It introduces no Swift, bundled assets, permissions, app configuration, signing or bridge-contract requirement. All14 native files and all recorded core fixture files remain unchanged.
limitations: This supplemental review does not claim the new workspace UI overlay was exercised by the earlier simulator fixture. Root owns assembled web/browser validation.
